text: じぶんの　ちからで　やってみよう！

structure.jp: じぶんの　ちからで

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.explanation: みる after the て-form of a verb means to try doing it and see how it goes. やってみる = 'try doing it'.

patterns.name: 〜よう
patterns.explanation: The よう ending means 'let's do it', an invitation or a push to act. やってみよう = 'let's try doing it'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing says what you use to do something. じぶんの ちからで = 'with your own strength', so 'on your own'.
